Context management is quietly becoming the core competency gap between agentic tools.
Claude Code has memory/compaction. Codex now has self-organizing threads. Cursor has rules files.
They're all solving the same problem: agents that degrade over long sessions. Different approaches, same bottleneck.

replies.name: Aleksander Lada
replies.text:
I've had this problem when I started building this project of mine. Essentially the agents would fight each other when trying to merge. So I had the orchestrator agent be the one to merge and resolve conflicts. It also actively works to prevent tasks that are going to touch the same components from running in different agents.

Problem is: that made the orchestrator agent way busier, so I couldn't talk to it without messing up its context. The solution was to have an orchestrator agent for the orchestrator agents, which is less concerned about the actual code and more about the project. Works really well!

https://t.co/NmLk9SHBEP

replies.text:
おかしい。うちのCodexは勝手に分岐とかチャットを作る機能はないと書いてるけど🤯
ところで、今日の私のCodex進化日記。インフォグラフィックに１日にしてならず。それぞれの学問分野で適切なクオリティがある。
まずはどんな目的のインフォグラフィックを作るかが大事。あなたのやりたいことは次のテストでいい点を取ることでしょ？
だったら、過去問の解答と答えを全て取り込んだマークダウンを作り、解答に必要な知識を赤字で出力するインフォグラフィックを作られねばならない。そして、チャッピー proと一緒にレイアウトを相談。改善点を洗い、５往復くらいすると形が決まってくる。
そして、Imagenを使う。絶対に、HTML、CSSで作らせない。
Imagenで作った画像にhtml、CSSを乗っけると綺麗に言葉が乗っかる。
理解系マークダウンを作った後は、勝手に、計画を立案させ、勝手にクロリティコントールさせるのが大事。こうすると、人間が介入せずに、レベルの高いインフォグラフィックが量産できる。
まとめ。最初の数日はインフォグラフを作るための仕込み期間。ここがうまくいけば後は自動化できるよ。
そして、その仕込みの仕方は分野ごとにモディファイが必要。
ただし、骨格は同じ。理解→計画→imagen→クオリティコントロールを分けること。

replies.name: Dominik F. Farr
replies.text: It needs a way to know the available models. I asked codex to create a new thread to do X and use "on of the spark" models for it. It created a new thread with a literal model "spark" which (of course) produced an error. Then it was smart enough to check my previous conversations in ~/.codex for a model that sounds correct and found "gpt...-spark". Maybe make it a bit easier for the agents. Giving them the ability to decide what level of intelligence is appropriate for a task seems like one of the major upsides of this new workflow.

quotes.name: Mahid (auto-didact)
quotes.text:
Agents.md rule I’m adding to my codex knowledge work agent setup:

Use visible agent threads as the coordination surface for long-horizon work.

The root thread should orchestrate, not hoard context.

For every independent task:
- search existing threads first
- reuse if goal/scope/boundary match
- create a new thread if it can advance independently

A good child thread has:
- one small goal
- exact scope
- working directory
- allowed tools
- evidence required
- explicit stop boundary

Use separate threads for research, inbox context, vendor discovery, payments investigation, docs/Notion synthesis, etc.

Don’t create worktrees for knowledge work.

Use worktrees only when code edits need isolation.

The orchestrator should read back only:
thread → goal → status → evidence → blocker → next action → owner

Not full transcripts.

Pin active/high-leverage threads.
Archive completed/stale/duplicate/blocked ones after evidence is captured.

Basically: make parallel agent work visible, bounded, and context-efficient.

"Codex가 스스로 작업을 관리하기 시작했어요!"
이제 에이전트 운영 패턴은...!

이제 작업을 운영하는 에이전트로 진화하고 있어요.

Codex가 자기 작업 스레드를 직접 만들고, 찾고, 정리하고, 중요한 스레드를 핀하고,, 여기에 병렬 작업을 위해 워크트리까지 띄울 수 있게 된거죠.

여기서 Codex팀 Nick의 패턴에서도 근본적인 패러다임이 완전히 바뀌었다고 하네요.

- 모든 작업이 나의 Chief of Staff 역할을 하는 하나의 지속적인 스레드 안에서 돌아감.

- 새로운 프로젝트나 업무 흐름이 시작될 때마다, 일종의 비서실장 역할을 하는 스레드한테 새 스레드를 만들도록 함. (이미 슬랙 등에서 필요한 맥락을 다 파악하고 있음)

- 비서실장 스레드는 정기적인 체크를 하면서 프로젝트 스레드들을 모니터링하고, 슬랙에서 나온 중요한 업데이트를 해당 스레드에 수시로 전달함. 모든 정보가 위로 자연스럽게 취합되는 구조.

이 구조가 재밌는 이유는 에이전트 사용의 중심이 작업 흐름을 계속 살아있게 유지하는 방향으로 옮겨가기 때문이라고 봐요.

여기에 Windows 지원도 중요한 변화예요. Computer Use 지원은 이제 Codex의 작업 공간을 더 확장하게 될거예요.

Codex 요즘 진짜 최고네요!

这个用法真的太酷了！

我最近也一直在把 Codex 当成“长期工作空间”用，而不是每次开一个新聊天。

我的做法很简单：

把最重要的工作固定成 10 个置顶 thread。

比如：
策略研发
数据基座
持仓管理
长内容
付费产品
视频分发
X 内容
Daily Rhythm
研究
个人系统

每个 thread 只管一条线。

在对应 thread 里，我可以一直往下聊、继续推进、收尾、写回状态。

真正关键的是：
聊天窗口只是操作现场。

任务状态、目标、下一步、证据，都要写回文件里的 SSOT。

这样 AI 才不会每次“重新认识你”。

它会越来越像一个长期协作的工作系统。

I think I found the interesting part behind the new Codex behavior: thread management is becoming toolable.

The newer build exposes more codex_app calls around threads — sending messages, renaming threads, and manipulating thread state. That’s a big shift from my previous approach of reading session JSONL files to reconstruct context and execution state.

Once threads are programmable objects, you can imagine a lot more: skills that spawn or continue threads, workflows that hand off work across projects/worktrees, and tooling that orchestrates Codex instead of prompting Codex to orchestrate itself.

This feels like a much more powerful control plane. 🧵

以Claude code为代表的TUI模式正在Codex打败

Codex刚刚出了一个功能，能让你管理多个聊天的对话的效率翻倍。

他们让Codex的一个聊天支持，管理其他聊天线程。管理线程可以创建、检查、pin、归档、组织，使用子线程。

这意味着你只要盯住一个聊天窗口工作就行，需要的时候再切换到对应的聊天窗口。避免你在频繁切换窗口和记忆失去心理状态。

如何使用呢？在任意先窗口输入：

扫描 GitHub 上的 bug 报告，然后针对看起来比较容易修复的 bug，在不同的 worktree 中创建新的线程去修复它们。对于最重要的任务，也把这些线程置顶。

你就能看到Codex开始创建新线程分配worktree，然后将重要线程置顶。这个和那种用完就放弃的Subagent完全不同，你可以将这些线程归档，随时review。

随着Codex的崛起，TUI这种违背用户体验的模式将会慢慢被抛弃。

因为人的心智资源是有限的，任何消耗心智资源的设计当有新的方案的时候，都会被慢慢替代。

Codex真的越来越好用了！！

quotes.name: Dagnum²
quotes.text:
Gate AI vs Lakera Guard at matched false-positive rates across 7 public prompt-injection benchmarks. 

Gate AI meets or beats Lakera on every row.

Codex just added self-managing threads that auto-pull Slack context and spin up parallel worktrees.

Every external source the agent pulls into its prompt is an indirect injection vector. 

Slack messages. 
GitHub issues. 
Docs. 
Calendar invites. 

When the agent manages itself, no human reviews what enters the context before it executes.

This is LLM01 on the OWASP Top 10 and the primary attack surface for coding agents in 2026. 

Gate scans every request and every response, in both directions. Indirect injections through tool outputs are a primary threat category.

The benchmark across 16 public datasets, one global threshold, no per-dataset tuning:

🎯97.4% F1 at 1% false-positive cap 
🎯#1 on 8 of 16 datasets 
🎯53ms median latency

Gate AI runs 6-17x fewer false positives than Lakera Guard. For coding agents, that's the metric that matters. False positives block legitimate code operations and break the workflow.

One base-URL swap. No code changes. Free tier with BYOK. 

Launching June 2026... https://t.co/7mkg4sJoxj

quotes.name: Nick
quotes.text:
This has fundamentally changed how I use Codex

- everything runs out of a single persistent thread (my "chief of staff")
- anytime I start a new project or workstream, I have that thread spin up a new thread (because it's already found the context from slack, etc)
- the CoS thread checks in on the project threads during heartbeats, and occasionally sends relevant updates from slack to that thread

everything flows naturally to the top
